_comment: One self-contained config per character (--config dadbod.json, or --conf). Unknown keys are ignored; a missing key keeps its code default. Edit and restart - values are read at runtime. Some runtime commands (e.g. 'hunt') save their change back to this file. Owner is OPTIONAL: leave it empty and the bot runs solo (no one commands it, owner-assist off).
_comment_mission: MISSION (blitz run): the mission-terminal sliders, exactly what the roll packet puts on the wire. Difficulty is the terminal's level slider (captures show 1/6/11; byte-clamped 0..255). The six sliders are WIRE values -100..+100, 0 = middle (terminal default), -100 = left end, +100 = right end - e.g. CreditsXp -100 rolls all-credit missions, +100 all-XP. MissionZones: zone names or playfield ids a mission may sit in (empty = any).
_comment_resupply: RESUPPLY: buying stims/rechargers in a shop ('resupply' command). Counts are of usable ones; targets are how many it tops back up to (stims in 25s, rechargers in 20s).
_comment_heal: HEAL: popping the carried stims (combat) / rechargers (out of combat) when health or nano falls under these % of max. The recharger is sit-only: the bot sits, waits for the server's echo, uses it and keeps sitting while it ticks, then stands - HealRestMaxSeconds caps one rest.
_comment_api: LOCAL API: GET /status /nav /inventory /log and POST /command on 127.0.0.1. 0 = off.
_comment_hunt: HUNT ('hunt' command): the pets fight hostiles within HuntRadius while the bot stays put (off until 'hunt on'). HuntMaxLevelMargin caps a target to best-attack-pet-level + margin (scales off the pet, not the player). HuntFactionMode Auto|On|Off - Shadowlands faction-safe hunting (Auto: on once a Redeemed/Unredeemed standing is set). HuntBlacklist: mob names never hunted. A 'hunt' command updates these and saves this file.
_comment_buffs: BUFF BOTS ('buffs' command): the public-buff-bot handshake (Chewy on RubiKa, Codedoc on RubiKa2019). Be un-teamed and near the bot, then 'buffs start': the bot invites, we accept, we send BuffRequestTells in order, it buffs and auto-kicks us. ALWAYS list the highest NCU buff first (it expands Max NCU so the rest fit). BuffBotName empty = no buff bot. (4a.1 is the plumbing; the buff selection is computed later.)
